+## 4. A–D 方案比较
+
+| 维度 | A. ext4 + Linux users/groups + ACL | B. rootless containers/userns + bind mounts | C. custody broker/API + encrypted store | D. shared UID + directory convention |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| isolation strength | 强（对非 root、非 docker 的不同 UID） | 中到强，取决于真正 rootless、subid、socket 与 bind policy | sealed data 很强；普通 scratch 仅中等 | 弱/无强隔离 |
+| implementation complexity | 中高 | 高 | 高 | 低 |
+| sudo/admin requirement | 初次建 user/group/root、ACL、audit/service 必需 | 安装/subid/可能 daemon setup 必需 | service/key/root/ledger setup 必需 | 无 |
+| Codex CLI compatibility | 可行，但需 per-principal home、auth、wrapper | 可行但复杂；TTY/auth/profile/bind 需逐项验证 | worker 通过 CLI + Unix socket；broker 非 Codex | 直接兼容，但不可信 |
+| Windows/WSL risk | VHDX 单点；Windows admin 可离线访问 | WSL/daemon/socket/namespace 多层复杂性 | key 与 broker 成新关键点 | Windows/WSL 风险无缓解 |
+| backup strategy | ext4 source + encrypted metadata-aware backup | volume/export + host backup，恢复复杂 | encrypted store + signed ledger checkpoint | 任意 copy，但无法证明 custody |
+| crash recovery | systemd + per-role checkpoint + lease/CAS | container state 不可信，必须外置 checkpoint | broker transaction/ledger 可重放 | scratch 容易混线 |
+| access logging | auditd + brokered paths；ACL 自身不记录 read | daemon + broker logs，仍需 host audit | broker 可记录每次 unseal/read | 只能靠应用自报 |
+| operational burden | 中高 | 很高 | 高 | 低 |
+| bypass risks | root/sudo/docker/Windows admin | host UID、rootful socket、错误 bind、subid 漂移 | broker bug、key theft、direct-store path | 同 UID 任意读取/篡改 |
+| verdict | **Primary foundation** | **Optional later hardening; current state no-go** | **Required with A for holdout** | **Rejected** |
+
+### 4.1 为什么 D 不能提供强认识论隔离
+
+POSIX 权限在 UID 层判断。两个 Codex worker 若都以 UID 1000 运行，应用层写下的“maker 不得看 model output”不会阻止 maker 进程直接打开同 UID 可读的 producer 文件、CLI session、checkpoint 或 credential。即使 CLI wrapper 拒绝，worker 仍可调用其他文件 API。**同 UID worker 可绕过应用层 deny，因此 D 不能生成可信的 blind-checker、holdout 或 independent-promotion receipt。**
+
+### 4.2 B 在当前机器上的特殊风险
+
+当前 Docker daemon 由 root 运行，socket 对 docker group 开放，当前交互账户属于该组。能调用该 socket 的 worker原则上可请求 host bind mount 或 privileged-like filesystem access；因此它可绕过 A 的普通文件 ACL。可行的 B 必须是另行批准的 rootless Podman/Docker user service，拥有独立 subuid/subgid、独立 socket、禁止 host durable root 的宽 bind，并由不同 role UID 各自运行。即便如此，sealed holdout 仍推荐只由 C 处理。
+
+## 5. 推荐的拟议系统设计
+
+### 5.1 Primary durable root 与 backup root
+
+**[拟议配置] Primary：**`proposed:/srv/cie9709`，必须位于 WSL ext4，不在 repo、worktree、`/tmp` 或 `/mnt/c` 下。
+
+**[拟议配置] Ledger：**`proposed:/var/log/cie9709/access-ledger.jsonl`，root/custody-broker owner；role workers 无直接 write，只能调用 broker append。
+
+**[拟议配置] Backup：**优先选择独立物理盘或远端备份目标上的 encrypted restic repository；若 Owner 只能先用 Windows mount，则可用 `proposed:/mnt/c/Users/<owner>/CIE9709Backup/restic` 保存**密文 repository**，但必须同时满足：
+
+- backup key 不在同一 Windows directory、不进 repo、不进 worker home；
+- backup 包含 content hash、principal UID/GID manifest、ACL dump、xattr/flag receipt、ledger checkpoint；
+- C: 当前仅约 93 GiB 可用，因此先做容量预算；
+- C: 不能成为唯一副本，且不得承载 holdout plaintext 或 POSIX ACL authority；
+- 在证明物理独立性前，C: 与 WSL VHDX 视为同一故障域。
+
+### 5.2 Principal 数量与 role mapping
+
+**[拟议配置] 推荐 11 个独立、non-login、无 sudo、无 docker、无共享 home 的 Linux service principals：**
+
+| Principal | Role | 不可兼任 |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `cie9709-maker` | Gold maker | checker、adjudicator、producer |
+| `cie9709-checker` | blind Gold checker | maker、adjudicator、producer |
+| `cie9709-adjudicator` | sealed disagreement adjudication | maker、checker、producer、promoter |
+| `cie9709-producer` | candidate production | Gold roles、verifier、promoter |
+| `cie9709-verifier` | hard-lane source-first verifier | producer、promoter、readback |
+| `cie9709-promoter` | release assembler/promoter | producer、verifier、readback |
+| `cie9709-readback` | product readback/rollback verifier | promoter、producer |
+| `cie9709-reviewer` | AO exact-SHA/evidence-chain reviewer | 任何被审生产角色 |
+| `cie9709-qualifier` | 冻结 prediction、不得读 Gold | evaluator、custodian |
+| `cie9709-evaluator` | prediction hash 后的 holdout evaluation | qualifier、producer |
+| `cie9709-custodian` | broker/service identity；管理 seal/unseal/ledger | 任意内容生产或 promotion |
+
+可复用的是基础 software package、只读 official-source bytes 和经 hash 固定的 schema；**不可复用的是 Linux UID、home/CODEX_HOME、CLI session、scratch、checkpoint、credential、AO context 和 trust-conflicting role。** Owner/root 是系统管理员，不计入这 11 个受限 principals，也不得签发 independence receipt。

+### 5.3 ACL directory tree
+
+所有路径均为 **`proposed:` 且未创建**：
+
+```text
+proposed:/srv/cie9709/
+├── source/official/                 # frozen official source, read-only by selected roles
+├── role-inbox/
+│   ├── maker/                       # maker-only write
+│   ├── checker/                     # checker-only write
+│   ├── adjudicator/                 # adjudicator-only write
+│   ├── producer/                    # producer-only write
+│   ├── verifier/                    # verifier commitment/write
+│   ├── promoter/                    # promoter assembly scratch
+│   └── readback/                    # readback receipts
+├── custody/
+│   ├── e1/maker-sealed/
+│   ├── e1/checker-sealed/
+│   ├── e1/adjudicated/
+│   └── holdout/{selection,gold,disagreement}/
+├── candidate/producer/
+├── verified/terminal-receipts/

+├── checkpoints/{role}/
+├── receipts/

+
+ACL 原则：root 持有 tree root；每个 role-inbox/checkpoint 只给 owner role `rwx`；共享 source 只给必要角色 `r-x`；custody/holdout 只给 custodian，evaluator 只经 broker 获得 gated result；producer 对所有 Gold/custody parent 无 traverse；promoter 只能写 staging，immutable release 由 broker 原子提交；reviewer 只读 receipts/release/exact-SHA checkout。
+
+POSIX ACL 没有 Windows 风格的显式 deny ACE。这里的 “deny” 必须通过**不授予 parent traverse/read、收紧 mask、不同 UID、无 sudo/docker/socket access**实现，并用 negative read probes 验证；不能只在表格里写 deny。

+任一 role principal 属于 `sudo`/`docker`、能读 custody key、能写 ledger 历史段、能直接写 immutable release、或 negative read probe 意外成功，相关 qualification/review receipt 立即 `invalidated_by_leakage`。

+### 5.5 Secret/key custody 与 holdout unseal
+
+**[拟议配置]** sealed store 使用 authenticated encryption；key 由 `cie9709-custodian` service 通过 systemd credential 或 root-only key file 获得，Owner 持有离线 recovery copy。key 不进入 repo、environment dump、worker home、Windows backup directory或 PR artifact。
+
+**[拟议配置] unseal protocol：**
+
+1. qualifier 先提交包含 input/prompt/schema/render/model/normalizer/evaluator-code hash 的 prediction envelope；
+2. broker 用 Unix `SO_PEERCRED` 验证 caller UID、qualification key 与 envelope hash；
+3. broker 追加 `unseal_requested` ledger event，并拒绝旧/stale/重复 key；
+4. 只有 evaluator principal 获得一次性 evaluation handle；明文留在 broker memory 或受控 tmpfs/memfd，不写 repo/worktree/Windows mount；
+5. broker 输出 aggregate/diff receipt，追加 `unseal_completed` 与 hash；raw Gold 不回传 qualifier/producer；
+6. ledger gap、UID mismatch、hash mismatch、ACL drift 或重复 unseal 均 fail closed。
+
+`chattr +a` 仅作为防误改层；真正的 append-only 保证来自 broker 单写者、每条 event 的 `prev_hash`、周期 signed checkpoint 和外部 encrypted backup。root 仍能清 flag/改文件，所以不能把 `+a` 宣称为对 root 的密码学不可变性。
+
+### 5.6 Worker start、crash/resume 与 rollback
+
+**[拟议配置] worker start：**由 root-owned systemd template unit 或受控 launcher 以固定 UID、固定 `HOME/CODEX_HOME`、只读 repo checkout、精确 ACL writable prefixes 启动；unit 显式 deny `/var/run/docker.sock`、其他 role homes 与 custody path。不得用当前 UID 1000 同时启动多个冲突角色。
+
+**[拟议配置] checkpoint：**每个 object/wave 完成原子 checkpoint，记录 baseline SHA、input/policy/ACL hash、role principal、lease、last terminal object、output hash 和 ledger offset。scratch 不作为恢复依据。
+

body:
![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

In POSIX ACLs, permissions granted to a directory do not automatically propagate to newly created files within that directory unless default ACLs are explicitly defined. Since the `cie9709-producer` will dynamically write candidate files to `/srv/cie9709/candidate/producer` and the `cie9709-verifier` needs to read them, you should also set default ACLs (`setfacl -d`) on this directory. Otherwise, new files created by the producer will not inherit the read permissions for the verifier.

```suggestion
sudo setfacl -m u:cie9709-producer:rwx,u:cie9709-verifier:rx,m::rwx /srv/cie9709/candidate/producer
sudo setfacl -d -m u:cie9709-producer:rwx,u:cie9709-verifier:rx,m::rwx /srv/cie9709/candidate/producer
# REQUIRES_OWNER_APPROVAL | NOT_EXECUTED
```

+**[拟议配置] Ledger：**`proposed:/var/log/cie9709/access-ledger.jsonl`，root/custody-broker owner；role workers 无直接 write，只能调用 broker append。
+
+**[拟议配置] Backup：**优先选择独立物理盘或远端备份目标上的 encrypted restic repository；若 Owner 只能先用 Windows mount，则可用 `proposed:/mnt/c/Users/<owner>/CIE9709Backup/restic` 保存**密文 repository**，但必须同时满足：
+
+- backup key 不在同一 Windows directory、不进 repo、不进 worker home；
+- backup 包含 content hash、principal UID/GID manifest、ACL dump、xattr/flag receipt、ledger checkpoint；
+- C: 当前仅约 93 GiB 可用，因此先做容量预算；
+- C: 不能成为唯一副本，且不得承载 holdout plaintext 或 POSIX ACL authority；
+- 在证明物理独立性前，C: 与 WSL VHDX 视为同一故障域。
+
+### 5.2 Principal 数量与 role mapping
+
+**[拟议配置] 推荐 11 个独立、non-login、无 sudo、无 docker、无共享 home 的 Linux service principals：**
+
+| Principal | Role | 不可兼任 |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `cie9709-maker` | Gold maker | checker、adjudicator、producer |
+| `cie9709-checker` | blind Gold checker | maker、adjudicator、producer |
+| `cie9709-adjudicator` | sealed disagreement adjudication | maker、checker、producer、promoter |
+| `cie9709-producer` | candidate production | Gold roles、verifier、promoter |
+| `cie9709-verifier` | hard-lane source-first verifier | producer、promoter、readback |
+| `cie9709-promoter` | release assembler/promoter | producer、verifier、readback |
+| `cie9709-readback` | product readback/rollback verifier | promoter、producer |
+| `cie9709-reviewer` | AO exact-SHA/evidence-chain reviewer | 任何被审生产角色 |
+| `cie9709-qualifier` | 冻结 prediction、不得读 Gold | evaluator、custodian |
+| `cie9709-evaluator` | prediction hash 后的 holdout evaluation | qualifier、producer |
+| `cie9709-custodian` | broker/service identity；管理 seal/unseal/ledger | 任意内容生产或 promotion |
+
+可复用的是基础 software package、只读 official-source bytes 和经 hash 固定的 schema；**不可复用的是 Linux UID、home/CODEX_HOME、CLI session、scratch、checkpoint、credential、AO context 和 trust-conflicting role。** Owner/root 是系统管理员，不计入这 11 个受限 principals，也不得签发 independence receipt。
+
+### 5.3 ACL directory tree
+
+所有路径均为 **`proposed:` 且未创建**：
+
+```text
+proposed:/srv/cie9709/
+├── source/official/                 # frozen official source, read-only by selected roles
+├── role-inbox/
+│   ├── maker/                       # maker-only write
+│   ├── checker/                     # checker-only write
+│   ├── adjudicator/                 # adjudicator-only write
+│   ├── producer/                    # producer-only write
+│   ├── verifier/                    # verifier commitment/write
+│   ├── promoter/                    # promoter assembly scratch
+│   └── readback/                    # readback receipts
+├── custody/
+│   ├── e1/maker-sealed/
+│   ├── e1/checker-sealed/
+│   ├── e1/adjudicated/
+│   └── holdout/{selection,gold,disagreement}/
+├── candidate/producer/
+├── verified/terminal-receipts/
+├── releases/{staging,immutable}/
+├── checkpoints/{role}/
+├── receipts/
+├── backup-metadata/{acl,xattr,principal-manifest}/
+└── quarantine/
+
+proposed:/run/cie9709/custody.sock
+proposed:/var/log/cie9709/access-ledger.jsonl
+```
+
+ACL 原则：root 持有 tree root；每个 role-inbox/checkpoint 只给 owner role `rwx`；共享 source 只给必要角色 `r-x`；custody/holdout 只给 custodian，evaluator 只经 broker 获得 gated result；producer 对所有 Gold/custody parent 无 traverse；promoter 只能写 staging，immutable release 由 broker 原子提交；reviewer 只读 receipts/release/exact-SHA checkout。
+
+POSIX ACL 没有 Windows 风格的显式 deny ACE。这里的 “deny” 必须通过**不授予 parent traverse/read、收紧 mask、不同 UID、无 sudo/docker/socket access**实现，并用 negative read probes 验证；不能只在表格里写 deny。
+
+### 5.4 Allow/deny matrix
+
+`R`=read，`W`=write own inbox/staging，`B`=只能经 broker，`A`=broker append，`—`=无 ACL/no traverse。
+
+| Role | Official source | E1 maker | E1 checker | Sealed 120 Gold | Candidate | Terminal verification | Staging release | Immutable release | Ledger |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| maker | R | W own | — | B write/seal only | — | — | — | — | B/A receipt |
+| checker | R | B reveal after commitment | W own | B write/seal only | — | — | — | — | B/A receipt |
+| adjudicator | R | B sealed R | B sealed R | B gated R | — | W adjudication | — | — | B/A receipt |
+| qualifier | frozen input R | — | — | — | W prediction | — | — | — | B/A receipt |
+| evaluator | frozen input R | — | — | B after prediction hash | R frozen prediction | W eval receipt | — | — | B/A receipt |
+| producer | scoped R | — | — | — | W own | — | — | — | B/A receipt |
+| verifier | R | — | — | — | R after commitment | W | — | — | B/A receipt |
+| promoter | receipt-linked R | — | — | — | R immutable candidate | R | W | R | B/A receipt |
+| readback | consumer source R | — | — | — | — | R | R | R | B/A receipt |
+| reviewer | repo/source refs R | — | — | — | R immutable only | R | R | R | R |
+| custodian | policy-scoped R | sealed custody | sealed custody | R/W encrypted | broker transfer | broker transfer | broker commit | broker commit | A |
+
+任一 role principal 属于 `sudo`/`docker`、能读 custody key、能写 ledger 历史段、能直接写 immutable release、或 negative read probe 意外成功，相关 qualification/review receipt 立即 `invalidated_by_leakage`。
+
+### 5.5 Secret/key custody 与 holdout unseal
+
+**[拟议配置]** sealed store 使用 authenticated encryption；key 由 `cie9709-custodian` service 通过 systemd credential 或 root-only key file 获得，Owner 持有离线 recovery copy。key 不进入 repo、environment dump、worker home、Windows backup directory或 PR artifact。
+
+**[拟议配置] unseal protocol：**
+
+1. qualifier 先提交包含 input/prompt/schema/render/model/normalizer/evaluator-code hash 的 prediction envelope；
+2. broker 用 Unix `SO_PEERCRED` 验证 caller UID、qualification key 与 envelope hash；
+3. broker 追加 `unseal_requested` ledger event，并拒绝旧/stale/重复 key；
+4. 只有 evaluator principal 获得一次性 evaluation handle；明文留在 broker memory 或受控 tmpfs/memfd，不写 repo/worktree/Windows mount；
+5. broker 输出 aggregate/diff receipt，追加 `unseal_completed` 与 hash；raw Gold 不回传 qualifier/producer；
+6. ledger gap、UID mismatch、hash mismatch、ACL drift 或重复 unseal 均 fail closed。
+
+`chattr +a` 仅作为防误改层；真正的 append-only 保证来自 broker 单写者、每条 event 的 `prev_hash`、周期 signed checkpoint 和外部 encrypted backup。root 仍能清 flag/改文件，所以不能把 `+a` 宣称为对 root 的密码学不可变性。
+
+### 5.6 Worker start、crash/resume 与 rollback
+
+**[拟议配置] worker start：**由 root-owned systemd template unit 或受控 launcher 以固定 UID、固定 `HOME/CODEX_HOME`、只读 repo checkout、精确 ACL writable prefixes 启动；unit 显式 deny `/var/run/docker.sock`、其他 role homes 与 custody path。不得用当前 UID 1000 同时启动多个冲突角色。
+
+**[拟议配置] checkpoint：**每个 object/wave 完成原子 checkpoint，记录 baseline SHA、input/policy/ACL hash、role principal、lease、last terminal object、output hash 和 ledger offset。scratch 不作为恢复依据。
+
+**[拟议配置] resume：**新 worker 以同 role principal 启动，从 durable checkpoint 读取；先 reconcile lease/CAS，再比较 main SHA、manifest、policy、qualification key、ACL hash 和 ledger continuity。任一变化将 checkpoint 标记 stale，并从最后一个已验证 terminal object 重放；不得复制旧 worker context 或跨 role resume。
+
+**[拟议配置] rollback：**停止 role units，冻结新的 broker writes，签发 ledger checkpoint，将可疑 output 移入 quarantine（不删除），恢复上一 immutable release pointer，运行全量 consumer readback 与 denied-read probes；只有 Owner 批准后才做 teardown。
+
+### 5.7 Disaster recovery
+
+1. 在干净 WSL instance 上安装冻结版本工具；
+2. 重建相同 principal names，并根据 encrypted principal manifest 恢复 UID/GID mapping；
+3. 恢复 durable bytes、ACL dump、xattrs/flags 和 ledger；
+4. 验证 content hash、ledger chain、release pointer 与 key availability；
+5. 运行 maker/checker/producer/promoter/holdout 全套 denied-read probes；
+6. 以全新 rehearsal release 做 consumer readback，不直接恢复生产指针；
+7. Owner 签发 DR acceptance receipt 后才允许重新 admission。
+
+Windows C: 上的密文副本若与 WSL VHDX 同盘，只覆盖“VHDX 逻辑损坏/误删”的部分风险，不覆盖整盘损坏、Windows account compromise、ransomware 或容量耗尽。生产级 DR 至少需要一个不同物理/管理故障域的副本。
